# TukdaQR

TukdaQR is a free, open source, browser-only UPI QR code generator and Indian political satire project created by a3ro.dev.

## What it does

- Splits a payment total into UPI QR codes of no more than ₹1,999 each.
- Encodes standard `upi://pay` links.
- Lets users download individual QR codes or print all of them.
- Processes the UPI ID, account name, amount and note locally in the browser.
- Has no account system, payment backend, analytics or advertising trackers.

## Political context

On 15 September 2026, India's Ministry of Finance announced a 0.4% merchant discount rate on specified person-to-merchant UPI payments above ₹2,000. Person-to-person payments remain free, customers should not pay the MDR, and exemptions apply to covered small merchants and some payment categories.

TukdaQR responds to the ₹2,000 threshold with the satirical line: “₹2,000 is policy. ₹1,999 is maths.” The project criticises complex policy design and bureaucracy. It does not promise a fee exemption or provide financial or legal advice.
